name: Squamous cell skin cancer
theme: the dangerous sibling · the transplant multiplier

meta.title: Cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma in silico decision trainer
meta.condition: Cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma (localized, locally advanced, and metastatic), adult
meta.population: Adults with cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma - THE DANGEROUS SIBLING: the same sun, the same clinic, the same surname on the margin receipts as the BCC trainer next door - but this disease metastasizes (~2-5% overall, memory-grade; far higher with high-risk features) and kills (US deaths estimated comparable to melanoma in some regions - the Karia 2013 claim, quoted as the estimate it is), while remaining registry-UNCOUNTED (>700,000 US cases/yr, verified estimate; SEER excludes NMSC). The router is the NCCN stratification - now THREE tiers (low / high / VERY-high risk) - with the verified BWH T-staging beside it. THE MULTIPLIER POPULATION is modeled as an input: immunosuppressed patients (organ-transplant recipients above all) carry a 65-250x SCC multiplier (re-homed to the Euvrard 2003 review by this run's sweep) and their prevention evidence does NOT transfer (nicotinamide verified positive in immunocompetent ONTRAC, verified NEGATIVE in transplant recipients). The adjuvant chapter just closed in OPPOSITE directions - C-POST positive and FDA-approved, KEYNOTE-630 negative - the registry's cleanest anti-class-effect lesson.
meta.summary: Evidence-linked teaching application for the commonest cancer's dangerous sibling. THE PAIRED ADJUVANT RECEIPT is the spec's centerpiece: C-POST (adjuvant cemiplimab after surgery+RT in high-risk disease - NEJM 2025, PMID-verified) was POSITIVE with DFS HR 0.32 (24-month DFS 87.1% vs 64.1%, verified snippet) and produced an FDA approval 2025-10-08 (secondhand, dated), while KEYNOTE-630 (adjuvant pembrolizumab, the SAME setting) was NEGATIVE at ASCO 2025 (no PMID matched - cited to the abstract) - same question, opposite answers, one drug class: the cleanest anti-class-effect lesson in the reg…
meta.disclaimer: Synthetic teaching environment. Not medical advice; every number is a claim with a citation and an expiry date.
meta.classification: NCCN cSCC risk stratification (low / high / very-high risk - secondhand, guideline-grade; the 2022-stratification validation paper URL-matched as optional support) + BWH tumor staging (proposal AND validation PMID-verified; n=1,818) - location, diameter, depth, differentiation, perineural invasion (caliber rules secondhand), immunosuppression
meta.response: Margins and recurrence for the local chapters (the 4mm-vs-6mm escalation verified - Brodland and Zitelli 1992, the attribution this run's sweep CORRECTED); DFS for the adjuvant turn (C-POST 24-month DFS 87.1% vs 64.1%, verified snippet - carried as the LABELED endpoint it is, displayed never ranked); ORR for advanced disease (EMPOWER-CSCC-1 metastatic ORR 47% verified snippet)

Newly diagnosed.name: Standard excision, 4mm margins (low-risk - the office cure)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: the low-risk standard (NCCN secondhand; margin anchor verified)
Newly diagnosed.evidence: verified margin anchor + guideline convention; figure flagged
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: an office procedure and a scar
Newly diagnosed.patient: For low-risk lesions: a straightforward office excision with a small safety margin cures the spot.

Newly diagnosed.name: Margin-controlled surgery, escalated margins (high / very-high risk)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: the high-tier standard (NCCN secondhand; AUC + BWH verified)
Newly diagnosed.evidence: verified staging and AUC anchors; figure flagged teaching estimate
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: bigger surgery, possible RT - the trade against this sibling's real metastatic risk
Newly diagnosed.patient: For higher-risk lesions: the margin-checking surgery with wider safety margins - because this type can travel, the surgery is more thorough and the follow-up watches the lymph nodes too.
drugs: Mohs micrographic surgery / excision at >=6mm (+ adjuvant RT per features)

Newly diagnosed.name: Adjuvant cemiplimab after surgery + RT (the C-POST turn - very-high tier)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: the very-high-tier adjuvant standard (C-POST verified; approval secondhand dated)
Newly diagnosed.evidence: randomized phase 3 (PMID-verified; DFS verified snippet) + FDA approval (secondhand)
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: the PD-1 ledger added to the surgical one - accepted against a 36-point DFS gap
Newly diagnosed.patient: For the highest-risk cases after surgery and radiation: a year of preventive immunotherapy - the trial showed it cut recurrences by two-thirds, and it was approved in 2025.

Newly diagnosed.name: Definitive radiotherapy (the non-surgical candidate's road)
Newly diagnosed.evidence: series-grade, honestly unanchored; the adjuvant-chemo null verified (TROG 05.01)
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: local skin reaction; late cosmetic change
Newly diagnosed.patient: For people who cannot have surgery: a course of radiation cures most localized lesions.

Newly diagnosed.name: Checkpoint inhibitor, advanced disease (the three-drug space)
Newly diagnosed.evidence: single-arm phase 2 receipts (EMPOWER ORR verified snippet); survival figure flagged teaching estimate
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: the PD-1/PD-L1 ledger; REJECTION RISK in transplant recipients (the mTOR-switch receipt - secondhand)
Newly diagnosed.patient: For disease too advanced for surgery or radiation: immunotherapy - three approved options that shrink roughly a third to a half of tumors, sometimes durably.

Newly diagnosed.name: Comfort-focused care
Newly diagnosed.guideline: always on the menu, never by drift
Newly diagnosed.patient: Comfort-focused care is a real choice - expert wound care and symptom control.

Relapsed / recurrent.name: Margin-controlled salvage surgery (local recurrence)
Relapsed / recurrent.guideline: the recurrent-local convention (AUC verified; NCCN secondhand)
Relapsed / recurrent.evidence: consensus + verified AUC; figure flagged teaching estimate
Relapsed / recurrent.toxicity: re-operation in treated tissue; RT's ledger where added
Relapsed / recurrent.patient: A returned lesion gets the thorough margin-checking surgery, often with radiation - and afterward may qualify for the preventive immunotherapy.

Relapsed / recurrent.name: Checkpoint inhibitor if IO-naive - and the open gap after it
Relapsed / recurrent.guideline: the IO-naive standard; past it, the gap said as a gap
Relapsed / recurrent.evidence: single-arm phase 2 (ORR verified snippet); the post-IO space convention/flag-grade
Relapsed / recurrent.toxicity: the checkpoint ledger; rejection risk in OTRs

refs.label: NCCN Squamous Cell Skin Cancer guideline: the THREE-tier stratification (low / high / very-high risk - location, diameter, borders, recurrence, immunosuppression, prior RT, differentiation, PNI, depth) - SECONDHAND, guideline-grade (no PMID by design; none fabricated). Optional URL-matched support: 'Validation of the 2022 NCCN Risk Stratification for cSCC' (PMID 37285135, seen URL+title)

BWH T-staging, both halves VERIFIED: proposal (Jambusaria-Pahlajani, JAMA Dermatol 2013 - PMID 23325457, pubmed-url-match) + validation (Karia, JCO 2014 - PMID 24366933, pubmed-url-match; n=1,818 tumors verified snippet): diameter, depth beyond fat, poor differentiation, PNI - the features that concentrate metastases and deaths

Surgical margins for primary cSCC - BRODLAND and Zitelli, JAAD 1992 (PMID 1430364, pubmed-url-match): 4mm standard / >=6mm for high-risk features (>=2cm, grade >=2, subcutaneous invasion, high-risk site - verified snippet). THE ATTRIBUTION CORRECTION (the stack's 6th premise correction, applied BACKWARD into the open skin-bcc PR): the briefing said 'Wolf/Zitelli' - the pair shares only the senior author (Wolf and Zitelli 1987 = the BCC paper, 3813602)

AAD/ACMS/ASDSA/ASMS 2012 Mohs appropriate use criteria (PMID 22959232, pubmed-url-match): 270 scenarios - 200 appropriate / 24 uncertain / 46 inappropriate (verified snippet); cSCC-specific scenario detail secondhand

EMPOWER-CSCC-1: cemiplimab in advanced cSCC (Migden, NEJM 2018 - PMID 29863979, pubmed-url-match): metastatic ORR 47% (28/59; 95% CI 34-61 - verified snippet). FDA 2018-09: the FIRST advanced-cSCC approval ever (secondhand, dated). THE NEWS-CAPSULE CONFUSABLE documented: PMID 29921845 ('Cemiplimab effective in cutaneous SCC') sits beside the real paper

KEYNOTE-629 pembrolizumab, BOTH cohort papers matched - THE COHORT-SPLIT TRAP documented: R/M cohort (Grob, JCO 2020 - PMID 32673170, pubmed-url-match; ORR ~34% memory-grade) and LA cohort (PMID 34293460, pubmed-url-match; ORR ~50% memory-grade) are DIFFERENT papers - quoting the LA ORR under the R/M PMID is a live trap. FDA 2020-06 R/M, 2021-07 LA (secondhand). HRQoL companion 37943491 (matched)

Cosibelimab-ipdl (Unloxcyt, PD-L1): FDA approved 2024-12-13 for mCSCC/laCSCC not candidates for curative surgery/RT - the THIRD approved checkpoint inhibitor (secondhand, dated; late-2025 label update on longer-term data press-grade). Three drugs, zero head-to-heads - said

C-POST: adjuvant cemiplimab or placebo in high-risk cSCC after surgery+RT (Rischin/Porceddu, NEJM 2025 - PMID 40454639, pubmed-url-match): DFS events 24 vs 65, HR 0.32, 24-month DFS 87.1% vs 64.1%, n=415 - ALL verified snippet. FDA approved adjuvant cemiplimab 2025-10-08 (sBLA - secondhand, dated). THE PRIMARY-VS-COMPANION SET documented: 40862828 (impact analysis) and the NEJM correspondence sit beside the primary

KEYNOTE-630: adjuvant pembrolizumab in high-risk LA cSCC after surgery+RT - NEGATIVE: did not meet its RFS primary endpoint; no OS benefit ('cannot be recommended as standard of care') - NO PMID MATCHED; cited to the ASCO 2025 abstract (JCO.2025.43.16_suppl.6000, secondhand). THE PAIRED RECEIPT with C-POST: same setting, same class, opposite answers - pembrolizumab is on NO adjuvant card, property-enforced

TROG 05.01 (Porceddu, JCO 2018 - PMID 29537906, pubmed-url-match): post-op RT +/- carboplatin in high-risk head/neck cSCC - carboplatin added NO benefit (the published null conclusion; one search snippet paraphrased the direction backward - trap documented, spec pinned to the published result). THE MUCOSAL CONFUSABLE documented: 18091334 (mucosal H&N postop RT+/-chemo) repeatedly surfaced for this query

Neoadjuvant cemiplimab in resectable stage II-IV cSCC (Gross, NEJM 2022 - PMID 36094839, pubmed-url-match): pCR ~51% (memory-grade - snippet said only 'high percentage'). THE ADJACENT-TRIAL CONTAMINATION documented: DISCERN's 73% pCR surfaced in the same searches - QUARANTINED, never imported. Setting discipline: neoadjuvant receipts do not transfer to adjuvant cards

THE MULTIPLIER POPULATION, receipts at their corrected homes: 65-250x SCC (and ~10-16x BCC) magnitudes RE-HOMED to Euvrard 'Skin cancers after organ transplantation' (NEJM 2003 - PMID 12711744, pubmed-url-match; magnitudes memory-grade) - the 7th premise correction, applied backward into the skin-bcc PR; PMID 20410852 (matched) carries the DIFFERENT subsequent-KC claim. TUMORAPA sirolimus switch (Euvrard, NEJM 2012 - PMID 22830463, pubmed-url-match; 5-yr follow-up 30016177 matched; effect sizes memory-grade). Nicotinamide VERIFIED NEGATIVE in transplant recipients (NEJM 2023 - PMID 36856616, pubmed-url-match). IO-in-OTR: mTOR-switch + cemiplimab phase 1 - ORR 46%, zero rejections, one cross-taper death (JCO 2024, secondhand)

ONTRAC nicotinamide (Chen, NEJM 2015 - PMID 26488693, pubmed-url-match): n=386, 500mg BID x12mo - NMSC -23%, SCC -30%, BCC -20% (verified snippet). The IMMUNE-STATUS SPLIT: verified NEGATIVE in transplant recipients (36856616) - prevention receipts do not transfer across immune status

THE SUNSCREEN RECEIPT, home with its nuance: Nambour RCT (Green, Lancet 1999 - PMID 10475183, pubmed-url-match) - the person-based PRIMARY endpoint was NULL ('no significant differences in incidence of first new skin cancers', verified snippet - the endpoint trap the sweep caught); the SCC prevention claim rides tumor counts + the verified long-term follow-up (van der Pols, CEBP 2006 - PMID 17132769, pubmed-url-match: 'SCC but not BCC can be prevented'; ~40% lower SCC tumor rates over 8 years, verified snippet)

THE BURDEN RECEIPTS: Karia/Schmults US estimate (JAAD 2013 - PMID 23375456, pubmed-url-match): >700,000 US cases/yr, registry exclusion noted in the paper itself (verified snippet); estimated deaths 3,932-8,791/yr 'may rival melanoma in central/southern US' - MEMORY-GRADE numbers, quoted only as the Karia 2013 claim. Metastasis ~2-5% overall: convention-grade, memory (per-feature receipts not verified this sweep - flagged). SEER excludes NMSC (standing denominator honesty)

VA field-5-FU chemoprevention (VAKCC - Weinstock, JAMA Dermatol 2018: 'Chemoprevention of Basal and Squamous Cell Carcinoma With a Single Course of Fluorouracil, 5%, Cream' - PMID 29299592, pubmed-url-match): n=932 veterans, 2x/day x4wk face/ears (verified snippet); the ~75%-reduction-in-year-1-SCC headline memory-grade, flagged

THE OPEN POST-ANTI-PD-1 GAP + THE MELANOMA-ONLY TRAP: no approved or dedicated phase-3 door exists after anti-PD-1 failure in cSCC (the space runs through baskets and oncolytic phase 1-2 - stated as a ~16-search finding, not proven absence). RP1/vusolimogene: CRL 2025-07-22, second CRL 2026-04-10, then ACCELERATED APPROVAL 2026-08-06 in anti-PD-1-progressed MELANOMA ONLY (+nivolumab) - the trials sweep CORRECTED the briefing's memory of a 2025 approval; CERPASS (RP1+cemiplimab in cSCC) MISSED both primaries (2023-12). RP1 is never carded here - property-enforced. PH-762 intratumoral (fully enrolled 2025-11; AAD 2026 path-response data) is shelf, not card
refs.src: registry + press sweep (secondhand, dated; RP1 saga corrected)

refs.label: Cetuximab phase 2 in unresectable cSCC (Maubec, JCO 2011) - NOT URL-VERIFIED this sweep: FLAGGED, cited by journal only (no PMID assigned); platinum-era regimens convention-grade. The pre-IO shelf, honestly graded

THE SHELF, dated, secondhand: neoadjuvant pembrolizumab NCT05025813 and nivolumab+relatlimab NCT06288191 - EXISTENCE-ONLY (statuses unverified); ruxolitinib-in-OTR NCT04807777 existence-only; Dana-Farber flu-window NCT06664151 est. completion 2026-08-30 (may be closing NOW); PH-762 fully enrolled 2025-11; VET3-TGI basket (not cSCC-named). EMPTY BUCKETS SAID: no cooperative-group cSCC trial surfaced; no post-PD-1 phase 3; no US Mohs-vs-excision RCT; US OTR-prevention effectively empty - SPRINTR (nicotinamide successor) is CANADIAN (Women's College Hospital - NOT a US door); SiroSkin AUSTRALIAN. Cosibelimab late-2025 label update press-grade

El-Jawahri A, LeBlanc T, VanDusen H, et al. Effect of Inpatient Palliative Care on Quality of Life 2 Weeks After Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation: A Randomized Clinical Trial. JAMA 2016;316(20):2094-2103 (PMID 27893130, NCT02207322) — abstract read firsthand 2026-09-10. POPULATION CAUTION, added at that read because the previous label named no population at all: this is a SINGLE-INSTITUTION randomized trial of 160 adults with HAEMATOLOGICAL malignancy hospitalized for autologous or allogeneic stem-cell transplantation, and its outcomes are quality of life, depression, anxiety, fatigue and symptom burden — it reports no survival and no adverse-event table. It is the factory's standing anchor for the PRINCIPLE that palliative care runs alongside active treatment rather than after it; it is not evidence in this tumour type and is not the source of any number on this card.

ARTACUS (NCT04349436): RP1 oncolytic MONOTHERAPY in solid-organ/HCT transplant recipients with advanced cutaneous malignancies (cSCC-dominant) - phase 1b/2, Replimune; Part B expanding to heart/lung recipients; interim: responses without graft-loss signal (AACR 2024/EJC 2025, secondhand). Recruiting per institutional pages 2024-2025 (Dana-Farber, Duke, UCSF) - 2026 REGISTRY STATUS UNCONFIRMED, flagged - web-verified 2026-08-20, re-check due. The flagship door FOR the multiplier population
